title: OONTuda
description: OONTuda is a chaotic and hilarious server-side plugin for Minecraft 1.21.4 that adds a unique consequence to player kills.
body:
OONTuda is a chaotic and hilarious server-side plugin for Minecraft 1.21.4 that adds a unique consequence to player kills.

When a player kills another player, there's a chance that a squad of UN peacekeepers — armed zombies and skeletons — will spawn on the spot to "neutralize" the aggressor. These mobs are relentless, targeting only the player who committed the kill, and won't stop until the threat is eliminated (or they're taken down).

This plugin is perfect for anarchy servers, PvP arenas, or any server where you want to add a unpredictable, lore-friendly twist to player combat.
